lanes.tip: Alpha (α): a major period of 4 Saros intervals; the catalogue holds 18 (the last one is cut off). One Alpha is 5 β. Named in words with its quarter: Peak, Node, Valley or End.
Beta (β): a major period, depth 2. 5 of them make an α; one is 13 γ. Named in words with its quarter: Peak, Node, Valley or End.
Gamma (γ): a major period, depth 3. 13 of them make a β; one is 5 δ. Named in words with its quarter: Peak, Node, Valley or End.
Delta (δ): a major period, depth 4. 5 of them make a γ; one is 5 ε. Named in words with its quarter: Peak, Node, Valley or End.
Nuclide (ε): a minor unit, depth 5. 5 of them make a Delta (δ); one is 77 Helions (η). Named ε#1 … ε#5 inside its Delta.
ζ (depth 6) lies between the units: one cycle is 11η, 7 of them make a Nuclide (ε). A cycle is named by where it starts: 1η, 12η, 23η … 67η.
Helion (η): a minor unit, depth 7. 77 of them make a Nuclide (ε); one is 36 Preons (ι). Numbered 1η … 77η inside its Nuclide.
θ (depth 8) lies between the units: one cycle is 4ι, 9 of them make a Helion (η). A cycle is named by where it starts: 0ι, 4ι, 8ι … 32ι.
Preon (ι): a minor unit, depth 9. 36 of them make a Helion (η); one is 65 Flavons (λ). Counted 0ι … 35ι inside its Helion.
κ (depth 10) lies between the units: one cycle is 13λ, 5 of them make a Preon (ι). A cycle is named by where it starts: 0λ, 13λ, 26λ … 52λ.
Flavon (λ): a minor unit, depth 11. 65 of them make a Preon (ι); one is 25 Blinks (ν). Counted 0λ … 64λ inside its Preon.
μ (depth 12) lies between the units: one cycle is 5ν, 5 of them make a Flavon (λ). A cycle is named by where it starts: 0ν, 5ν, 10ν … 20ν.
Blink (ν): the finest unit, depth 13, and the device's real-time tick. 25 of them make a Flavon (λ). Counted 0ν … 24ν inside its Flavon.
ξ (depth 14) is finer than the Blink: one cycle lasts 0.14ν, 7 of them make a ν. A cycle is named by the decimal Blink it starts at.
